title: 이러닝(전자학습)산업 발전 및 이러닝 활용 촉진에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.text_en: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy ( Engineering Design Division ), 044-203-4341

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「이러닝산업(전자학습) 발전 및 이러닝 활용 촉진에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Promotion of the Development of the E-learning Industry (Electronic Learning) and the Utilization of E-learning and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
[Wholly Amended Jan. 26, 2012]
Article 2 Deleted <January 26, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(표준화) 「이러닝(전자학습)산업 발전 및 이러닝 활용 촉진에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제11조제1항제4호에서 “그 밖에 이러닝의 표준화에 관하여 산업통상부령으로 정하는 사업”이란 이러닝 표준화와 관련된 국제기구 또는 국외단체와의 교류ㆍ협력에 관한 사업을 말한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Standardization) In Article 11, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Act on the Development of the E-learning Industry and Promotion of the Use of E-learning (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the“other projects concerning the standardization of e-learning prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy” refers to projects concerning exchange and cooperation with international organizations or foreign entities related to e-learning standardization. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>
[Wholly Amended Jan. 26, 2012]
Article 4 Deleted <Aug. 18, 2015>
Article 5 Deleted <Aug. 18, 2015>
Article 6 Deleted <Aug. 18, 2015>
Article 6-2 Deleted <Aug. 18, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(중소기업의 이러닝 지원) ① 산업통상부장관은 법 제16조제2항 및 제3항에 따라 중소기업의 이러닝 도입 및 운영을 위하여 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 비용을 예산의 범위에서 지원할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Support for E-learning by Small and Medium Enterprises) ① Pursuant to Article 16, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the Act, the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energymay provide support, within the limits of the budget, for any of the costs falling under any of the following subparagraphs for the introduction and operation of e-learning by small and medium enterprises. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 이러닝시스템 구축을 위한 하드웨어 설비의 구입비 및 임대사용비
rows.text_en: 1. Purchase costs and rental fees for hardware equipment to establish the e-learning system

rows.source_ko: 2. 이러닝과 관련된 소프트웨어의 구입비 및 임대사용비
rows.text_en: 2. Purchase costs and rental fees for e-learning software
3. Production, purchase, and rental usage fees for e-learning content

rows.source_ko: ② 산업통상부장관은 중소기업의 이러닝에 대한 지원방법 및 지원절차 등에 필요한 세부적인 사항을 정하여 고시할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy may prescribe and announce detailed matters necessary for support methods and procedures, etc., regarding e-learning for small and medium-sized enterprises. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>
[Wholly Amended Jan. 26, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(이러닝센터 지정의 신청) ① 「이러닝(전자학습)산업 발전 및 이러닝 활용 촉진에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제16조제2항 전단에 따라 이러닝센터로 지정받으려는 자는 별지 제5호서식의 이러닝센터 지정신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 관계 중앙행정기관의 장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 8. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Application for Designation as an E-learning Center) ① Any personwho intends to be designated as an E-learning Center pursuant to the first part of Article 16, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Development of the E-learning (Electronic Learning) Industry and Promotion of E-learning Utilization (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall submit an application for designation as an E-learning Center in the form of Annex 5, attached with the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs, to the head of the relevant central administrative agency. <Amended Aug. 18, 2015>
1. Articles of Incorporation (applicable only to corporations)
2. Current Status of Professional Personnel and Operation Plan

rows.source_ko: 3. 시설 및 장비의 보유현황 및 운용계획서
rows.text_en: 3. Current Status of Facilities and Equipment and Operation Plan
4. Project implementation plan (including financing plan)

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 지정 신청을 받은 관계 중앙행정기관의 장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인등기사항 증명서를 확인하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of the relevant central administrative agency who has received an application for designation under Paragraph 1 shall verify the certificate of corporate registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act.
[Wholly Amended Jan. 26, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(이러닝센터 지정사항의 변경 신청) 영 제16조제2항 후단에 따라 이러닝센터로 지정받은 자가 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사항을 변경하려는 때에는 별지 제6호서식의 이러닝센터 지정사항 변경신청서에 이러닝센터 지정증 및 변경내용을 증명할 수 있는 서류를 첨부하여 관계 중앙행정기관의 장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Application for Change of Designated E-learning Center Matters) When a person designated as an e-learning center pursuant to the latter part of Article 16, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree intends to change any of the matters falling under any of the following subparagraphs, he/she shall submit an application for change of designated e-learning center matters in the form of Annex 6 to the head of the relevant central administrative agency, attaching the certificate of designation of the e-learning center and documents proving the details of the change.
1. Corporate name or trade name
2. Representative's Name
3. Address or location of the principal office
[Wholly Amended Jan. 26, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(이러닝센터지정서) 영 제16조제3항에 따른 지정서는 별지 제7호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Designation Certificate for E-learning Centers) The designation certificate pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 7.
[Wholly Amended Jan. 26, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제10조의2(이러닝사업자의 신고 사항 및 절차) ① 법 제20조의4제1항에 따른 신고를 하려는 자는 별지 제8호서식의 이러닝사업자 신고서(전자문서로 된 신고서를 포함한다)를 산업통상부장관(법 제20조의4제2항에 따라 신고업무를 대행하게 한 경우에는 그 기관 또는 단체를 말한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 10-2 (Matters and Procedures for Reporting by E-learning Business Operators) ① Any person who intends to make a report pursuant to Article 20-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit the E-learning Business Operator Report Form ( Form No. 8 of the Attached Form) (including a report form in the form of an electronic document) to the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy ( referring to the agency or organization where the reporting duties have been delegated pursuant to Article 20-4, Paragraph 2 of the Act ; hereinafter the same applies in this Article). <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 이러닝사업자는 이러닝사업에 관한 계약을 체결한 경우 그 실적을 별지 제9호서식의 이러닝사업수행 실적신고서(전자문서로 된 신고서를 포함한다)에 이러닝사업 내용을 증명할 수 있는 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 산업통상부장관에게 제출할 수 있다. 이 경우 산업통상부장관은 신고된 내용의 확인을 위하여 필요한 때에는 이러닝사업의 발주자, 보험ㆍ보증업무 수행기관 등에게 신고된 내용의 확인을 요청할 수 있다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② In the event that an e-learning business operator has entered into a contract regarding an e-learning business, the operator may submit the performance results thereof to the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy by attaching documents (including electronic documents) capable of proving the details of the e-learning business to the Report on Performance of E-learning Business (Form No. 9) attached hereto. In this case, if necessary to verify the reported details, the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy may request verification of the reported details from the client of the e-learning business, the insurance or guarantee business performing agency, etc. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 산업통상부장관은 이러닝사업자가 사업자 신고 및 이러닝 사업수행실적에 대한 확인서의 발급을 신청한 경우에는 별지 제10호서식의 이러닝사업자 신고확인서(전자문서로 된 확인서를 포함한다) 또는 별지 제11호서식의 이러닝사업 수행실적확인서(전자문서로 된 확인서를 포함한다)를 발급하여야 한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ When an e-learning business operator applies for the issuance of a confirmation certificate regarding business registration and e-learning business performance results, the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy shall issue a Confirmation Certificate of E-learning Business Operator Registration in Form No. 10 (including a confirmation certificate in the form of an electronic document) or a Confirmation Certificate of E-learning Business Performance Results in Form No. 11 (including a confirmation certificate in the form of an electronic document). <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 법 제20조의4에 따른 이러닝사업자 신고업무 등에 관하여 필요한 사항은 산업통상부장관이 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 through 3, matters necessary for the reporting duties, etc. of e-learning business operators pursuant to Article 20-4 of the Act shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>
[This Article Newly Inserted Jan. 26, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(이러닝산업 및 이러닝 활용 실태조사의 조사주기) 영 제20조에 따른 이러닝산업 및 이러닝 활용 실태조사의 조사사항 중 같은 조 제1호 및 제2호의 사항은 매년 조사하고, 같은 조 제3호부터 제6호까지의 사항은 산업통상부장관이 필요하다고 인정하는 때에 조사한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Survey Cycle for the Survey on the Status of the E-learning Industry and E-learning Utilization) Among the matters to be surveyed in the Survey on the Status of the E-learning Industry and E-learning Utilization pursuant to Article 20 of the Enforcement Decree, the matters under Subparagraphs 1 and 2 of the same Article shall be surveyed annually, and the matters under Subparagraphs 3 through 6 of the same Article shall be surveyed when the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy deems it necessary. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>
[Wholly Amended Jan. 26, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제12조(조사표) 산업통상부장관은 영 제20조에 따른 조사사항별로 조사표를 설계ㆍ작성하고, 조사방법은 산업통상부장관이 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2013. 3. 23., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Survey Form) The Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy shall design and prepare a survey form for each matter under investigation pursuant to Article 20 of the Enforcement Decree, and the investigation method shall be determined by the Minister and announced. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Oct. 1, 2025>
[Wholly Amended Jan. 26, 2012]
Article 13 Deleted <Aug. 18, 2015>
ADDENDA <Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy Decree No. 243, July 30, 2004>
This rule shall take effect on July 30, 2004.

rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Knowledge Economy Decree No. 1, Mar. 3, 2008> (Enforcement Rule of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Knowledge Economy and Its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Articles 2  through 4 omitted

rows.text_en: Article 5 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① through ㊹ Omitted

rows.source_ko: ㊺ 이러닝(전자학습)산업발전법 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ㊺ The Enforcement Rules of the E-learning (Electronic Learning) Industry Development Act are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제2조제3호, 제4조제3항, 제7조제1항ㆍ제2항, 제11조, 제12조, 별지 제1호서식 중 “산업자원부장관”을 각각 “지식경제부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 2, subparagraph 3; Article 4, paragraph 3; Article 7, paragraphs 1 and 2; Article 11; Article 12; and Form No. 1 of the Appendix, “Minister of Commerce, Industry and Energy” shall be changed to “Minister of Knowledge Economy”.
In Articles 2 and 3, “Ordinance of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy” shall be changed to “Ordinance of the Ministry of Knowledge Economy”.
Omitted from ㊻ to <64>
ADDENDA <Ministry of Knowledge Economy Decree No. 241, Jan. 26, 2012>
This rule shall take effect on January 26, 2012.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <산업통상자원부령 제1호, 2013. 3. 23.> (산업통상자원부와 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy Decree No. 1, Mar. 23, 2013> (Enforcement Rule of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. <단서 생략>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso Omitted>
Articles 2  through 6 omitted

rows.source_ko: 제7조(다른 법령의 개정) ①부터 ㊳까지 생략
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① through ㊳ omitted

rows.source_ko: ㊴ 이러닝(전자학습)산업 발전 및 이러닝 활용 촉진에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ㊴ The Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Development of the E-learning (Electronic Learning) Industry and the Promotion of E-learning Utilization are partially amended as follows.
In Article 3, “Ordinance of the Ministry of Knowledge Economy” shall be changed to “Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy”.

rows.source_ko: 제4조제3항, 제7조제1항 각 호 외의 부분, 같은 조 제2항, 제10조의2제1항, 같은 조 제2항 전단ㆍ후단, 같은 조 제3항ㆍ제4항, 제11조 및 제12조 중 “지식경제부장관”을 각각 “산업통상자원부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 4, Paragraph 3; the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 7, Paragraph 1; Paragraph 2 of the same article; Article 10-2, Paragraph 1; the first and second parts of Paragraph 2 of the same article; Paragraphs 3 and 4 of the same article; Article 11; and Article 12, “Minister of Knowledge Economy” shall be replaced with “Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy.”

rows.source_ko: 별지 제1호서식, 별지 제3호서식, 별지 제4호서식, 별지 제8호서식부터 별지 제11호서식까지 중 “지식경제부장관”을 각각 “산업통상자원부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Forms No. 1, No. 3, No. 4, and Forms No. 8 through No. 11, “Minister of Knowledge Economy” shall be changed to “Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy”.
In Form No. 3 of the Attached Appendix, “Ministry of Knowledge Economy” shall be changed to “Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy.”
Sections 5 through 63 are omitted.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <산업통상자원부령 제108호, 2014. 12. 31.> (규제 재검토기한 설정 등 규제정비를 위한 경제자유구역의 지정 및 운영에 관한 특별법 시행규칙 등 일부개정령)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy Decree No. 108, Dec. 31, 2014> (Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on the Designation and Operation of Free Economic Zones, etc. for Regulatory Reform, Including Setting Regulatory Review Periods)
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy Decree No. 153, Aug. 18, 2015>
This enforcement rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <산업통상자원부령 제448호, 2022. 1. 21.> (고압가스 안전관리법 시행규칙 등 36개 산업통상자원부령 일부개정령)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy Decree No. 448, Jan. 21, 2022> (Partial Amendment to 36 Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy Decrees, including the Enforcement Rule of the High-Pressure Gas Safety Management Act)
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <산업통상부령 제1호, 2025. 10. 1.> (산업통상부와 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy Decree No. 1, Oct. 1, 2025> (Enforcement Rule of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 부칙 제5조에 따라 개정되는 부령 중 이 규칙 시행 전에 공포되었으나 시행일이 도래하지 않은 부령을 개정한 부분은 해당 부령의 시행일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, among the Ministerial Ordinances amended pursuant to Article 5 of the Addenda, the parts amending Ministerial Ordinances that were promulgated prior to the enforcement of this Rule but whose effective date has not yet arrived shall enter into force on the effective date of said Ministerial Ordinance.
Articles 2  through 4 omitted
